notes: No argument reports the current C color level.
C search_block accepts the sparse prefix and updates PRF_COLOR_1.
C search_block accepts the normal prefix and updates PRF_COLOR_2.
C search_block accepts the complete prefix and enables both color bits.
C search_block accepts the off prefix and clears both color bits.
The on alias recursively selects the complete level.
Reports after each transition reflect the exact C bit-level state.
Unknown levels emit the exact C usage line without changing state.
any_one_arg consumes only the first token, so trailing input is ignored.
